chinese: 来自遥远星系的消息-编号1266202
english: Message from a Distant Galaxy—No. 1266202

chinese: 遥远银河深处，一颗九成地表被温热浅海包裹的热带行星。\\n\\n从轨道俯瞰，宽广的海洋上散布着无数大小不一外形不同的岛屿，奶白色沙滩沿着曲折海岸线绵延，海礁与高崖上的灯塔为繁盛的航运贸易昼夜轮转着，滨海城邦的高楼顺着海湾层层铺开，碧海间游弋着白帆游轮与观光快艇。这是一个处于原子时代的前超光速文明，适宜的全球性热带气候塑造了温和的文明思潮。在这一前提下诸多岛屿城邦逐渐联合在一起以一种十分平和稳定的方式完成了全球大一统，未曾经历阵痛的文明仍如孩童一般天真。\\n\\n清澈的大海反射出星河的倒影人们自顾自的认为在高天之上如同孤岛的星球上仍有与自己相似的存在。在诸多因素的影响下，文明大力发展旅游业并预设了各种不同形态的外星来客降临观光的设施，他们相信如此的美丽风景与温和气候一定能使可能存在的外星来客流连忘返。\\n\\n于是，无知的文明竖起极其原始的深空广播阵列，向银河传达他们的善意。\\n\\n§H让所有跋涉星海、被工作与族群压力束缚的旅人，拥有一处无需拘束的避风港。§!\\n\\n这句发向深空的宣传语刻在各个景区的观光石碑上，也是对外宣传坚持的信条。\\n\\n循环播放的广播伴随着海浪、椰风与轻音乐，日复一日向深空传递。本土居民们满怀期待，沙滩上搭建了无数观光驿站，港口常年预留空置泊位，留出大片临海空地。\\n\\n所有人都怀揣着善意，期待远道而来的星际访客。只是没人预料到这份邀请会引来§R远超§!他们认知的客人。
english: Deep in the distant Milky Way lies a tropical planet whose surface is 90 percent covered by warm, shallow seas. \\n\\nViewed from orbit, the vast ocean is dotted with countless islands of varying sizes and shapes, with milky-white sandy beaches stretching along the winding coastline, while lighthouses on sea reefs and high cliffs guide the bustling maritime trade day and night. The skyscrapers of coastal city-states spread out in tiered layers along the bays, and white-sailed cruise ships and sightseeing speedboats glide through the azure waters. This is a former faster-than-light civilization in the Atomic Age; its pleasant, global tropical climate has fostered a mild and harmonious cultural ethos. Under these conditions, numerous island city-states gradually united to achieve global unification in a remarkably peaceful and stable manner; this civilization, having never experienced the growing pains of upheaval, remains as innocent as a child. \\n\\nThe crystal-clear sea reflects the Milky Way, and people naturally assume that on planets high in the heavens—isolated like islands—there are still beings similar to themselves. Influenced by numerous factors, the civilization vigorously developed its tourism industry and established various facilities designed to accommodate extraterrestrial visitors of all kinds. They believed that such beautiful scenery and a mild climate would surely make any potential extraterrestrial visitors linger and refuse to leave. \\n\\nThus, this uninformed civilization erected a rudimentary deep-space radio array to convey their goodwill to the Milky Way. \\n\\n§H To provide all travelers who have journeyed across the starry seas—those bound by the pressures of work and their communities—with a haven free from constraints.§!\\n\\nThis promotional slogan, broadcast into deep space, is engraved on tourist monuments throughout the scenic areas and serves as the civilization’s steadfast creed for external outreach. \\n\\nThe looping broadcast, accompanied by the sound of waves, the coconut breeze, and light music, was transmitted into deep space day after day. Filled with anticipation, the local residents set up countless tourist rest stops on the beaches, kept berths vacant at the port year-round, and reserved large tracts of open land along the coast. \\n\\nEveryone is filled with goodwill, eagerly awaiting interstellar visitors from afar. Yet no one could have anticipated that this invitation would attract guests whose scale far exceeded their wildest imaginations.

chinese: 看着这些平日运筹帷幄、撑起庞大疆域的巨娘领袖们，在烈日下奔波确实于心不忍。\\n\\n于是帝国给她们放了个假。巨娘们挑了一颗生态宜人的度假星球， 这是一颗没有踏入星空但觉醒程度很高的土著星球 原住民们因为热情好客大力发展旅游业将自己的星球改成了近乎度假星球的模板 随后通过原始的深空广播宣传他们那是银河各个种族解压释放的优秀旅游胜地 然后就引来了正巧在寻找解压放松游玩场所的群巨娘 于是...\\n\\n伴随着擢风踏浪的雷鸣脚步，六道巨大的身影迈入了这片蔚蓝的海岸，性格各异的领袖们此时都换上了清凉的泳装，享受这番来之不易的假日。\\n\\n他们分别是：\\n\\n§H鸟音山水，林凤，苏小白，橘子长，希瞳§!\\n\\n按理说五人的阵容已经足够，但眼前的蓝发少女§B烁瑄§!，是鸟音山水多年的挚交。听闻巨娘们在全宇宙搜刮“避暑胜地”，她特意赶来一聚。既然鸟音开口担保，我们很愿意她加入这场假日，也许她玩开心了之后就会加入我们呢\\n\\n看着鸟音、烁瑄、橘子长将这片海岸的浅水区当作浴缸，肆意泼水嬉闹，而在林凤、希瞳、苏小白巨大的玉足边上，钢铁巨舰和城市庄园如同玩具般摇摇欲坠。这才是真正的“巨娘级”消暑方式。既然烁瑄玩得开心，鸟音也展露了难得的笑颜，那一个前超光速时代的土著文明成为献给她们的礼物，倒也不是什么大问题。毕竟，她们快乐了，宇宙就和平了。
english: Seeing these Giantess leaders—who normally strategize from behind the scenes and hold up a vast empire—rushing about under the scorching sun was truly heartbreaking. \\n\\nSo the empire gave them a vacation. The Giantesses chose a vacation planet with a pleasant ecosystem, a planet that, though it had never ventured into deep space, was highly advanced in its own right. The indigenous people, driven by their warmth and hospitality, had vigorously developed tourism, transforming their world into a near-perfect model for a resort planet. They then used primitive deep-space broadcasts to promote it as an excellent destination for species across the galaxy to unwind and relax—which attracted a group of giant women who happened to be a place to unwind, relax, and have fun. And so...\\n\\nAccompanied by thunderous footsteps that parted the wind and crashed through the waves, six colossal Giantesses strode onto this azure coastline. The leaders, each with their own distinct personalities, had all changed into cool swimwear to enjoy this hard-earned holiday. \\n\\nThey were:\\n\\n§H Qinwen, Linfeng, Su Xiaobai, Ora, and Hitomi§!\\n\\nLogically, a group of five would have been enough, but the blue-haired girl before them, §B Shuoxuan§!, was Qinwen’s longtime close friend. Upon hearing that the “Giantesses” were scouring the entire universe for “summer retreats,” she made a special trip to join them. Since Shanshui vouched for her, we’re more than happy to have her join us for this getaway—maybe she’ll decide to join our group after she’s had her fill of fun!\\n\\nWatching Niao Yin, Shuoxuan, and Ora treat the shallow waters of this coastline like a bathtub, splashing and frolicking to their hearts’ content, while at the feet of Linfeng, Hitomi, and Su Xiaobai’s enormous jade-like feet, steel battleships and city estates teetered precariously like toys. This is the true “Giantess-class” way to beat the heat. Since Shuoxuan is having fun and Niao Yin has shown a rare smile, it’s no big deal that a pre-faster-than-light-era indigenous civilization has become a gift to them. After all, when they’re happy, the universe is at peace.

A Young Girl's Interactions with the City

chinese: 视线越过海湾的另一端，三位毛茸茸的巨娘正趴在后方的岛屿上晒太阳。而在这片繁华的海岸线与城市上空，另一组三人正以最悠闲的姿态，融入这场假日。\\n\\n烁瑄轻盈的躺在在摩天大楼与城市之间，淡黄色的眼眸里满是温柔。相比那些动辄用星球当跳蛋的巨娘，她此刻更像一位纯粹的邻家少女。与她相对而卧的鸟音，则托腮倚靠在高楼的边缘，用指尖推了推半框眼镜，也是巨大的体型。\\n\\n§Y烁瑄姐姐，此城虽小，却是小人文明倾尽心力为我们准备的祛夏消暑之地，枕在云端听这浪涛拍岸，倒是不错的消遣，放心，之前的银河广播都说了可以随便玩，不会有问题呢。§! \\n\\n鸟音显然很黏这位“姐姐”，话匣子一开，便兴致勃勃地与烁瑄玩闹了起来。\\n\\n而躺在另一侧的橘子长则大相径庭，她整个人趴在沙滩上，纠白的巨手肆无忌惮地探向下方的海湾，指尖胡乱拨弄着海面，掀起一阵阵令下方游船剧烈摇晃的白浪。\\n\\n度假村的小人们则时充当了助兴玩具的作用，惊慌的他们驾驶着舰船驶入了少女们的海港。虽然之前做好了接待预案，但第一次近距离接触如此巨大的少女们，他们还是有些心悸，但巨大泳装少女的诱惑也令他们欲罢不能。小人的舰船们便兵分两路，一队在烁瑄的足下游荡，另一队则是来到了橘子长的巨手之下。\\n\\n只要她们不把这颗星球的星核当沙包捏，他们应该不至于血本无归。
english: Across the bay, three furry Giantesses were basking in the sun on the island in the distance. And high above this bustling coastline and city, another trio was blending into the holiday atmosphere with the utmost leisure. \\n\\nShuoxuan lay lightly suspended between the skyscrapers and the city, her pale yellow eyes brimming with tenderness. Compared to those Giantesses who casually use planets as Vibrators, she looked more like a pure, ordinary girl next door at that moment. Lying opposite her, Niao Yin rested her chin on her hand as she leaned against the edge of a skyscraper, pushing her half-frame glasses up with her fingertips—she, too, was of immense stature. \\n\\n§Y Sister Shuoxuan, though this city is small, it’s a place where the civilization of Tiny People has poured their heart and soul into preparing a summer retreat for us. Resting on a cloud and listening to the waves crashing against the shore is quite a pleasant pastime. Don’t worry—the Milky Way Broadcast already said we can play however we like; there won’t be any problems. §! \\n\\nNiao Yin was clearly quite attached to this “sister”; once she started talking, she enthusiastically began playing and fooling around with Shuoxuan.\\n\\n In stark contrast, Ora, lying on the other side, was a completely different story. She was sprawled face-down on the beach, her massive, snow-white hands reaching unabashedly toward the bay below, her fingertips randomly churning the water and sending up waves of white foam that caused the boats below to rock violently.\\n\\nThe resort’s tiny people, meanwhile, served as playthings to liven up the scene. Panicked, they steered their ships into the girls’ harbor. Although they’d prepared reception plans beforehand, coming into such close contact with such enormous girls for the first time still made their hearts race—yet the allure of the giant girls in swimsuits was simply too irresistible to resist. The Tiny People’s ships split into two groups: one cruised beneath Shuoxuan’s feet, while the other sailed beneath Ora’s giant hand.\\n\\nAs long as the girls didn’t treat the planet’s core like a punching bag, the Tiny People shouldn’t lose everything.

chinese: §M烁瑄姐姐~这有几只小船着你这里开过来了呢。§!\\n\\n一支由几艘护卫舰组成的小型舰队沿着海湾缓缓开来，舰上人员即便躲在数百吨重的钢铁战舰上面对如山般大小的两位少女仍止不住的发抖。\\n\\n在纯粹放松的环境里，鸟音也放下了古风的腔调，与她的烁瑄姐姐共度这场假期。几架直升机缓缓升空快速靠近到附近围绕着少女的巨躯盘旋。\\n\\n§B嘛~？是来给咱们助兴的~§!\\n\\n烁瑄没有理会飞机上的小人用扩音器发出语调近乎哀求的陌生外星语，烁瑄虽然隐约察觉到情绪的不对，但是为了这次放松度假的初衷，暂且被抛置脑后。总之自身有局部回溯的能力，即便可能做了错事后续也不会有太大影响啦。\\n\\n§M嗯嗯~船上的小人都是主动来陪我们玩耍的~§!\\n\\n鸟音推了推眼镜，眼角流露出一丝不易察觉的如同恶作剧般的笑意。\\n\\n§B所以...它们就打咱的胸部吗~？§!\\n\\n在极端恐慌中，舰队指挥官下达了攻击命令，一时间各类炮火在烁瑄的胸部绽放出剧烈的火光。\\n\\n虽然烁瑄是温柔系巨娘，但此时此刻，她的玩心也被激了起来，轻轻驱散环绕在耳边嗡嗡作响的直升机，向着挣扎的舰队伸出双手。\\n\\n她的一双纤手轻捏住两艘小船，数百吨重的船瞬间就被捏了起来，一艘扔进了烁瑄柔软的乳肉中，而另一艘被塞进了一旁矜持的鸟音泳裤中。\\n\\n§B坏呢~§!\\n\\n鸟音闻言，心底那点矜持彻底丢到了天边。她展臂环住烁瑄的腰肢，整个人像小猫咪一样柔柔的贴了过去。\\n\\n§M烁瑄姐姐~咱也要……§!\\n\\n没了繁文缛节的阻挡，鸟音将自己温热的脸颊直接埋进了烁瑄那团柔软的乳肉之中。可怜的护卫舰在波涛般的乳肉海洋中上下沉浮，与鸟音细腻的面庞亲密接触。阳光将两人的肌肤晒得微烫，带着一点点对方体温与奶香的暖意扑面而来，烁瑄特有的体香，一瞬间就将鸟音的感官包裹。没有了帝国事务的紧绷，她在这方天地里只是个可爱的妹妹，鼻尖轻轻蹭着那片柔嫩的肌肤，那种被温柔、柔软与馨香彻底淹没的宁静感，让她舒服得眯起眼睛，发出了满足的轻吟。\\n\\n§M呜...烁瑄姐姐~暖暖的~§!\\n\\n感受着“姐姐”肌肤传来的滚烫体温，以及那份毫无保留的宠溺，鸟音的呼吸逐渐变得有些急促。她随手将岸边一辆满载乘客的大型客车拾起含在唇间，顺着柔软的曲线缓缓直起身，主动抬起手，捧住了烁瑄的脸蛋。烁瑄微微垂着眼帘，粉嫩的唇瓣带着温柔的笑意迎了上去。\\n\\n两人彻底沉浸在贴贴的依偎之中，忘记了周遭的一切。然而，巨娘们沉浸于温存时一个不经意的动作，对凡尘而言却是灭顶之灾。就在唇齿相依的缠绵间，鸟音的膝盖不自觉地向下挪动压下，巨大的足尖恰好错落在城市中繁华的区域。只听一阵雷鸣般的闷响，十几栋数百米的摩天大楼在不可阻挡的玉足推进下轰然倒塌，漫天的尘埃与建筑碎片向四周涌去，一时间惊呼与尖叫响彻整个足底，逃散的人流与跪地膜拜巨足的人群显出一副十分荒诞的画卷。\\n\\n足下尘暴肆虐，而她们也只顾着感受彼此的体香与温柔，根本没注意到呢。因为这座城市的崩解，只是假日里为她们助兴的一段小小插曲罢了。唇瓣短暂分离，可怜的客车被拉出一道晶莹的银丝悬空在双唇之间。烁瑄微喘着气，那双清澈的眼眸里满是化不开的温柔，而鸟音的脸上早已染上一抹绯红，连呼吸都带着滚烫的情欲。\\n\\n§M还不够呢……§!\\n\\n鸟音娇憨地嘟囔了一声，再次主动凑了上去。\\n\\n这一次，那两尊巨大的玉体间没有任向间隙。鸟音微微侧过头，搂紧烁瑄的脖颈，狠狠的加深了这个吻，唇间的车辆也在鸟音软舌的挑逗中送入烁瑄口中。烁瑄也顺应着她，纤长的手指滑过鸟音的后腰，温柔的轻抚她的腰肢。阳光将两人微热的肌肤映的温润，空气中那些独属于少女的体香，奶香，又在此刻彻底交缠在了一起...\\n\\n§M唔…烁瑄姐姐的嘴唇，好软…§!\\n\\n鸟音的声音在唇齿交缠中变得有些含糊不清，她沉醉在烁瑄的体温与香气里，身子不自觉地又往对方怀里靠去。然而，就是这轻轻一靠，她们巨大的娇躯发生了轻微的位移。鸟音那丰满的大腿外侧顺势压在了下方被碾成粉末的城市群上，而烁瑄搭在海湾边的一只巨大的玉足，在动情间下意识地往后一蹬，又将沿海的跨海大桥拦腰踩断。\\n\\n烟尘在脚下翻涌，可对半空中的两人来说，那不过是一块背景板，现在，无论是帝国，还是这座城市的存亡，都远不及面前少女们香唇的触感更值得在意呢。
english: §M Shuoxuan, sis~ There are a few small boats heading this way toward you. §!\\n\\nA small fleet consisting of several frigates slowly made its way along the bay. Even though the crew members were sheltered inside steel warships weighing hundreds of metric tons, they couldn’t help but tremble in the presence of the two girls, who were as tall as mountains. \\n\\nIn this purely relaxed setting, Niao Yin set aside her archaic tone to enjoy this vacation with her sister Shuoxuan. Several helicopters slowly took off, quickly approaching and circling around the girls’ massive forms. \\n\\n§B, huh~? You’re here to liven things up for us~§!\\n\\nShuoxuan paid no attention to the Tiny persons in the helicopters, who were speaking an unfamiliar alien language through loudspeakers in a tone bordering on pleading. Although she vaguely sensed that something was off, she pushed those feelings aside for the sake of her original goal: to relax and enjoy this vacation. After all, she had the ability to partially rewind time, so even if she did something wrong, it wouldn’t have much of an impact later on. \\n\\n§M Mm-hmm~ The tiny people on board are all here of their own accord to play with us~§!\\n\\nNiao Yin pushed up her glasses, a barely perceptible, mischievous smile flickering at the corner of her eye. \\n\\n§B So... they’re going to hit our chests~?§!\\n\\nIn a state of extreme panic, the fleet commander issued the attack order, and in an instant, all manner of artillery fire erupted into intense flashes of light across Shuoxuan’s chest. \\n\\nAlthough Shuoxuan was a gentle Giantess, her playful spirit was piqued at that very moment. She gently waved away the helicopters buzzing around her ears and reached out her hands toward the struggling fleet. \\n\\nHer slender hands gently grasped the two small boats; the vessels, weighing hundreds of metric tons, were instantly lifted into the air. She tossed one into the soft flesh of her breasts, while the other was tucked into the modest swimsuit worn by the demure Niao Yin standing beside her. \\n\\n§B Naughty~§!\\n\\nUpon hearing this, the last shred of reserve in Niao Yin’s heart vanished completely. She wrapped her arms around Shuoxuan’s waist and pressed herself against her as softly as a little kitten. \\n\\n§M Shuoxuan, big sis~ I want to…§!\\n\\nWith no formalities standing in her way, Niao Yin buried her warm cheek directly into Shuoxuan’s soft bosom. The poor escort ship bobbed up and down in the ocean of breast flesh, coming into intimate contact with Niao Yin’s delicate face. The sunlight warmed their skin until it felt slightly hot, and a wave of warmth—carrying a hint of each other’s body heat and the scent of milk—washed over them. Shuoxuan’s unique body scent instantly enveloped Niao Yin’s senses. Free from the tension of imperial affairs, she was simply a sweet little sister in this little world. Her nose gently brushed against that tender skin, and the sense of tranquility—being completely overwhelmed by tenderness, softness, and fragrance—made her close her eyes in comfort and let out a soft, contented moan. \\n\\n§Mmm... Sister Shuoxuan~ It’s so warm~§!\\n\\nFeeling the scorching body heat radiating from her “sister’s” skin, along with that unreserved doting affection, Niao Yin’s breathing gradually grew a bit more rapid. She casually picked up a large passenger bus loaded with passengers from the shore and held it between her lips. Following its soft curves, she slowly sat up and reached out to cup Shuoxuan’s face in her hands. Shuoxuan lowered her eyelids slightly, her rosy lips curving into a gentle smile as she met her. \\n\\nThe two were completely lost in their intimate embrace, oblivious to everything around them. However, a single careless movement by the Giantess while she was lost in tenderness proved to be a catastrophic disaster for the mortal world. Just as their lips and teeth were entwined in an intimate embrace, Niao Yin’s knee unconsciously shifted downward and pressed down, her enormous toes landing precisely in the city’s bustling district. A thunderous rumble echoed as more than a dozen skyscrapers, each hundreds of meters tall, collapsed with a crash under the unstoppable advance of her jade-like foot. Dust and debris surged in all directions, for a moment, cries of shock and screams echoed across the entire expanse beneath her foot, while the fleeing crowds and those kneeling in worship before the giant foot created a scene of utter absurdity. \\n\\nThe dust storm raged beneath their feet, yet they were so absorbed in savoring each other’s scent and tenderness that they didn’t even notice. After all, the city’s collapse was merely a minor interlude to liven up their holiday. Their lips parted briefly, and a delicate, crystalline silver thread—drawn from the poor bus—hung suspended between them. Shuoxuan was breathing slightly heavily, her clear eyes brimming with an unyielding tenderness, while Niao Yin’s face had long since flushed crimson, her very breath carrying the scorching heat of desire. \\n\\n§That’s not enough…§!\\n\\nNiao Yin murmured playfully, then leaned in again of her own accord. \\n\\nThis time, there was not a single gap between their two magnificent, jade-like bodies. Niao Yin tilted her head slightly, wrapped her arms tightly around Shuoxuan’s neck, and deepened the kiss fiercely; her soft tongue teased Shuoxuan’s lips, sending waves of pleasure into his mouth. Shuoxuan responded in kind, her slender fingers gliding over Niao Yin’s lower back as she gently caressed her waist. The sunlight cast a warm glow on their slightly flushed skin, and the unique, youthful scents—the scent of a young girl and the scent of milk—entwined completely in the air at that moment...\\n\\n§Mmm… Shuoxuan’s lips are so soft…§!\\n\\nNiao Yin’s voice grew slightly muffled as their lips and teeth entwined; she was intoxicated by Shuoxuan’s body heat and scent, her body unconsciously leaning deeper into Shuoxuan’s embrace. However, with just that gentle nudge, their massive, delicate bodies shifted slightly. The outer side of Niao Yin’s voluptuous thigh pressed down on the cluster of cities beneath them, crushing them to dust, while Shuoxuan’s massive, jade-like foot—resting on the edge of the bay—unconsciously kicked backward in the heat of the moment, snapping the coastal bridge in two. \\n\\nDust and smoke swirled at their feet, but to the two suspended in midair, it was nothing more than a backdrop. Right now, neither the fate of the empire nor the survival of this city mattered nearly as much as the sensation of the young women’s fragrant lips against their own.

chinese: 来度假吗？有点意思……\\n\\n很难让人想象这样的情况，一艘豪华的游轮，仅仅只是刚刚出海，却被天外的不速来客正好截胡。\\n\\n对方浅橘色的麻花辫，身形却如同庞然大物一般，看上去深不见底的海面，却仅仅只能没过少女的小腿，人们不知道发生了什么，人们也不敢相信眼前的景象。只是被少女的手指捏住夹板的两侧，下一刻，整艘船就开始在少女的手指间被轻轻提了起来。\\n\\n§H各位也是来度假的吗？恰好咱知道一处小岛……那边挺适合度假的呢~§!\\n\\n少女虽然如此说道，但是却并没有给小人选择的权利，而时间也没过太久，船却在突然间靠了岸——\\n\\n却是另一位少女，躺在海面上绵延不绝的双腿，伸向了远处的地平线。\\n\\n§H好了哦，你们预订的少女小岛已经靠岸，请乘客下船哦~§!\\n\\n谁敢下去？在场的所有人却无一人敢于尝试，在一个身躯堪比岛屿的巨娘身上，只怕是稍微动那么一下……对小人来说都是几乎毁天灭地的存在。但是没有办法，即使没有一个人感轻举妄动，也不代表橘子长会放过这些小人——以及正躺在海面上的鸟音山水。\\n\\n§H那好吧……那就只能，让咱暂时充当一下导游了哦，下一站，是‘鸟巢’哦~§!\\n\\n……什么？\\n\\n人们惊恐之间，少女已经将游轮推下了海，推到了鸟音的双腿中间，而另一个巨娘也很配合地将下装泳裤褪下，露出了湿润粉嫩的洞口。这一刻，所有人都知道这所谓的“鸟巢”是何物了，已经开始有人纷纷往船下跳，可在少女的双腿间，这样的小动作又怎能逃得掉呢？\\n\\n少女的阴穴泛着潮红，湿热的气息似乎在引诱着小人不断前进，逃入海中的小人们上浮换气时也不得不吸入少女的气息，随机双眼迷离自动游进女孩的温柔乡，等待着在里面一点一点地丧失反抗的能力，逐渐沦为自己的一部分……是啊，只需要在里面躺着就可以了……不用再努力地为了生活而活着，毕竟在这一刻，所有的度假都将是永久，所有剩余的时间也归类为了“永恒”。\\n\\n难道这样不好吗？\\n\\n鸟音穿上了自己的泳裤，微微收缩穴肉但似乎已经感觉不到小人在里面挣扎的触感了。\\n\\n§Memmmmmm，没有什么法律说不可以吧……没事，今天休假，这种事情，小人们应该有所准备吧。§!
english: On vacation? That’s interesting…\\n\\nIt’s hard to imagine a situation like this: a luxury cruise ship, having just set sail, is suddenly intercepted by an uninvited guest from outer space. \\n\\nShe had light orange braids, yet her figure was as massive as a colossus. The sea, which looked bottomless, barely reached the girl’s calves. People didn’t know what was happening, and they couldn’t believe the scene before their eyes. The girl simply gripped both sides of the deck with her fingers, and in the next moment, the entire ship began to rise gently between her fingers.\\n\\n§H Are you all here on vacation too? I just happen to know a little island… It’s a great spot for a vacation~§!\\n\\nAlthough the girl said this, she didn’t give the tiny people a choice. Before long, the boat suddenly pulled up to shore—\\n\\nonly to reveal another girl, her legs stretching endlessly across the sea’s surface, reaching all the way to the distant horizon. \\n\\n§H “All right, everyone. The ‘Maiden’s Island’ you booked has docked. Passengers, please disembark~” §!\\n\\nWho dares to get off? Not a single person present dared to try it. On the body of a Giantess as vast as an island, even the slightest movement… ...for these tiny people, even the slightest movement would be a catastrophe. But there was no choice. Even if not a single person dared to make a move, that didn’t mean Ora would let these tiny people off the hook—or Qinwen currently lying on the ocean’s surface.\\n\\n§H Alright then… I guess I’ll just have to step in as your tour guide for a bit. next stop is the ‘Bird’s Nest’~§!\\n\\n…What?\\n\\nAmid the crowd’s panic, the girl had already pushed the cruise ship into the sea, guiding it between Torine’s legs, while the other Giantess obligingly slipped off her swimsuit bottoms, revealing a moist, pink opening. At that moment, everyone realized what this so-called “Bird’s Nest” really was. People began jumping off the boat one after another, but how could such a small movement possibly escape detection between the girl’s legs?\\n\\nThe girl’s vagina glowed with a flushed hue, and the hot, damp scent seemed to lure the tiny people ever forward. Even as they surfaced for air after fleeing into the sea, they were forced to inhale the girl’s scent; their eyes would grow hazy, and they’d automatically swim into her realm of pleasure, waiting to lose their ability to resist bit by bit, gradually becoming a part of her… Yes, all they have to do is lie there… No more struggling to survive—after all, at this moment, every vacation becomes permanent, and all remaining time is categorized as “eternity.”\\n\\nIsn’t that wonderful?\\n\\n Bird Sound put on her swimsuit, slightly tightening her vaginal muscles, but she no longer seemed to feel the Tiny people struggling inside her.\\n\\n§Memmmmmm, there’s no law against it, is there… It’s fine; I’m on vacation today. The Tiny people should be prepared for this sort of thing, right?§!
I’m starting to envy the tiny people a bit.

chinese: §H实在是……有点累了啊……§!\\n\\n暂时脱离群体身着泳装的橘子长回到岸上，戴上了遮阳帽，穿上了她特殊定制的雨靴——即使是在夏日炎炎，其她巨娘的身体都大面积裸露的情况下，她这副宛如拍摄写真一样的衣服还是引起了更多人的围观……当然，也少不了偷拍和背后蛐蛐。\\n\\n§Y你们说……为什么这个家伙要拿着个木牌把前面盖住啊……\\n\\n水深勿近？为什么要写这样的牌子？难道说……§!\\n\\n在电视塔的顶端，正在人们突然谈论的时候，却突然面前一暗，随后对面的人群开始出现了恐慌的表情：\\n\\n因为刚刚还在沙滩上的橘色巨娘，此刻仅用自己的身体，就已经将这座小小的电视塔包围了起来。\\n\\n§H你们在说什么呢？橘子长……听不清呢。只不过——§!\\n\\n§H咱只知道今天休假，所以……现在的咱不是行政官的话，是不是可以肆无忌惮地……做我想做的事情呢？§!\\n\\n少女说着，张开了自己粉嫩的口腔。所有人都知道这无底洞下都有些什么——任何人，建筑物，舰船，星球甚至是一个恒星系，都可能在她的身体中，在胃液的冲刷下逐渐沦为她身体的一部分。粉红色的舌苔轻轻拂过电视塔的外围，接触的玻璃在此刻应声破碎，随着少女的呼吸吞入了口腔内。然而，最令人恐慌的，恐怕是这些即将要成为橘子长特供“零食”的小人们。\\n\\n随后，随着少女轻轻的呼吸，却有着难以想象的引力，在将身体不由自主地向那粉红色的深渊中吸去。直到被舌苔包裹，如同柔软的苔藓一般，却带着湿润和温热的气息。但是被紧紧包裹住的身体却时刻给予自己危险的信号：此刻在少女的口腔中，只要她愿意，自己可能永远都会沦为食物被消化掉，甚至不会太久，自己渺小的身体都难以想象会对她深不见底的胃提供多少的情绪价值。想到这里，身体不由得颤栗起来。却在这惊骇的情绪中被少女细腻的感官追猎。或许……这位巨娘就是想看到你被她欺负却没有任何办法的恐慌，但是你却没有任何办法：毕竟从一开始，就是自己在蛐蛐人家不是吗？\\n\\n§H好了……咱记住你了哦，好好表现，我可能还会……再品尝你一次，改天。§!\\n\\n宛如从冥界中打了个滚一般，几乎难以呼吸的惊骇中，身体却完好无损地被少女吐出，宛如失去了情绪价值的糖果一般。小人蜷缩在电视塔顶，身上的衣服早已被少女的舌头撕扯的破破烂烂，挂满了巨娘的唾液。但总而言之，自己算是在她的手里……在她的口中活下来了，不是吗？
english: §H is really… a little tired…§!\\n\\nHaving temporarily stepped away from the group, Ora, dressed in a swimsuit, returned to shore. She put on a sun hat and slipped into her custom-made rain boots—even on a sweltering summer day, when the other Giantesses were mostly bare, her outfit—which looked like something straight out of a photo shoot—still drew even more onlookers… Of course, there were plenty of people taking secret photos and whispering behind her back.\\n\\n§Y Hey, guys… why is this guy holding up a wooden sign to block the view up ahead…?\\n\\n“Deep Water—Keep Out”? Why would he put up a sign like that? Could it be that… §!\\n\\nAt the top of the TV tower, just as people were suddenly discussing this, everything suddenly went dark in front of them, and the crowd across the way began to look panicked:\\n\\nBecause the orange Giantess who had been on the beach just moments ago had now, using only her own body, completely surrounded this small TV tower. \\n\\n§H What are you guys talking about? Ora… I can’t hear you clearly. But—§!\\n\\n§H All I know is that I’m on leave today, so… if I’m not an administrator right now, doesn’t that mean I can do whatever I want without holding back?§!\\n\\nAs the girl spoke, she opened her pink mouth. Everyone knew what lay within that bottomless pit—any person, building, ship, planet, or even an entire star system could gradually become part of her body, eroded by her stomach acid. Her pink tongue gently brushed against the outer surface of the TV tower; the glass it touched shattered instantly and was swallowed into her mouth with her breath. However, what was most terrifying were likely the tiny people who were about to become Ora’s special “snacks.” \\n\\nThen, as the girl breathed softly—yet with an unimaginable gravitational pull—her body was involuntarily drawn into that pink abyss. Until it was enveloped by the tongue’s surface, soft like moss, yet carrying a moist and warm breath. Yet his tightly encased body constantly sent him warning signals: right now, inside the girl’s mouth, if she so chose, he might forever remain as food to be digested; indeed, it wouldn’t be long before his tiny body—which he could scarcely fathom—would provide little emotional value to her bottomless stomach. At this thought, his body shuddered involuntarily. Yet even in the midst of this terror, he was hunted by the girl’s delicate senses. Perhaps… this Giantess just wants to see the panic on your face as she bullies you, leaving you completely helpless—but you really have no way out: after all, you were the one who walked into her lair in the first place, weren’t you?\\n\\n§H Alright… I’ll remember you, okay? Behave yourself, and I might just… savor you again someday. §!\\n\\nAs if I’d been tossed about in the underworld, I was spat out by the girl—intact, though—amidst a terror so suffocating I could barely breathe, like a piece of candy that had lost its emotional value. The tiny person curled up at the top of the TV tower, his clothes long since torn to shreds by the girl’s tongue and drenched in the Giantess’s saliva. But all in all, he’d managed to survive in her hands… in her mouth, hadn’t he?

chinese: 在巨娘们一同降临欢声笑语、疯狂的玩闹游戏的告一段落后，这场席卷整个小人首都圈的破坏游戏并未结束。作为破坏游戏的第二幕，希瞳、苏小白和林凤三人便与鸟音她们暂别，在相邻的城市群划定了一片专属她们的崭新“游乐场”。在蔚蓝天空下，三道高达数千米的娇躯缓缓降落。夏日的泳装上还沾着上一场游戏留下的些许烟尘，而遮天蔽日的阴影已然瞬间将这整座繁华的沿海都市笼罩。被推搡在最前方的林凤此刻还处于极度懵逼的状态，她有些困惑地揉了揉眼睛：\\n\\n§U哎？我们这是……到了吗？§!\\n\\n还没等她完全清醒，三双完美无瑕的白皙裸足已经踏上地面。轰隆——！海水在剧烈的震荡中掀起数百米高的海啸，金色的沙滩连同上面数以万计、惊恐尖叫的小人，在一瞬间被巨足无情地碾入最深的地底，成为了黏在巨娘脚底的微小红点。希瞳微微眯起眼，惬意地看着眼前波澜壮阔的海景，舒爽地感叹道：§Y真好啊——§!而她的脚跟此刻正猫咪磨爪般漫不经心地在一片豪华度假别墅区上残忍地研磨，将其化为一片看不出原貌的血浆与钢筋混合物。\\n\\n这时，站在中位的苏小白伸出葱指，在虚空中点开了一块闪烁的全息面板。\\n\\n§M这次的游戏规则非常简单：摧毁度越高、KD（击杀数）越震撼，能兑换的奖励就越丰厚。§!\\n\\n看着这个规则，性格主动的希瞳和小白对视一眼，嘴角同时勾起一抹坏笑。她们立刻一前一后将毫无防备的林凤围在中间。被两位坏坏的同伴硬生生推向城市中心的林凤，一边慌乱地挥舞着手臂，一边口中直呼“不要啦”。然而，当林凤的好胜心被激发起来后，她开始也变得无比积极，抬起那双柔嫩的巨足，沉重地踏向了市中心最密集的摩天大楼群。此时，在那些高达数百米的高楼内部，无数渺小的人类正陷入彻底的绝望。透过碎裂的玻璃外墙，他们只能惊恐地看到一片遮天蔽日的粉嫩足底正带着无上威压缓缓逼近。无数小人在密闭的空间里如无头苍蝇般疯狂奔逃、互相践踏，惨叫声连成一片。而林凤只是微微加了一点点力气，足弓向下轻轻一压，整座坚固的金融中心大厦便如同沙滩上的沙堡一般，在娇嫩的脚底板下脆弱地崩碎爆开，化作无数的尘埃。\\n\\n看到林凤玩得起劲，苏小白虽然有些无可奈何地叹了口气，但为了自己志在必得的奖励，她也开始在城市里优雅地漫步。她那几条巨大的、遮天蔽日的粉色狐尾在空中狂乱地扫过，每一次摆动都像抹布一样，将成片的住宅区彻底抹平。希瞳此时正微微歪着头，一言不发地凝视着脚下宛如蚁穴般混乱的惨烈景象。那双足以遮天蔽日的巨大赤足并未急着大肆践踏，而是在想着某种恶作剧般的坏心思，不紧不慢地悬停在横跨海湾的超级大桥上空。她故意用白皙粉嫩的脚趾在大桥上方轻轻晃动，巨大的阴影在桥面上忽明忽暗，肆意逗弄着那数百辆辆正疯狂逃窜、连成火龙的汽车。眼看着桥上的小人们因这无处可逃的巨足而陷入歇斯底里的恐慌与绝望，希瞳嘴角的坏笑愈发浓郁。终于，在小人们惊恐的惨叫达到顶峰的瞬间，她看似漫不经心地向下落足。那娇嫩完美的巨足 “轰隆”一声将整座宏伟的超级大桥拦腰压断。桥面上的无数车辆在巨大的重压下被无情地踩成纤薄的铁饼。希瞳甚至愉悦地微微转动了一下脚踝，用精致的足跟在断裂的桥墩上恶劣地研磨了几下，任凭那些绝望的哀嚎被无情地碾碎，连同合金残骸一起，轻巧地踢入翻滚的海浪中。
english: After the Giantesses arrived together, bringing laughter and wild, playful games, this game of destruction that had swept through the entire Tiny Person Capital Area was far from over. As the second act of the game of destruction, Hitomi, Su Xiaobai, and Linfeng bid a temporary farewell to Niao Yin and the others, carving out a brand-new “playground” exclusively for themselves in a neighboring city cluster. Under the azure sky, three slender figures, each towering thousands of meters high, descended slowly. Their summer swimsuits were still speckled with a trace of dust left over from the previous game, and a shadow large enough to block out the sun instantly engulfed the entire bustling coastal metropolis. Linfeng, who had been shoved to the very front, was still in a state of utter bewilderment; she rubbed her eyes in confusion: \\n\\n§U Huh? Are we… here already?§!\\n\\nBefore she could fully come to her senses, three pairs of flawless, fair, bare feet had already touched the ground. Boom—! Amid violent tremors, the sea water surged into a tsunami hundreds of meters high. The golden sandy beach—along with the tens of thousands of terrified, screaming Tiny persons on it—was mercilessly crushed by the giant foot into the deepest depths of the earth in an instant, reduced to tiny red specks stuck to the Giantess’s soles. Hitomi narrowed her eyes slightly, gazing contentedly at the magnificent ocean vista before her, and sighed with satisfaction: §Y, this is so wonderful—§! Meanwhile, her heel was casually grinding—like a cat sharpening its claws—across a luxury resort villa complex, mercilessly reducing it to an unrecognizable mixture of blood and rebar. \\n\\nAt that moment, Su Xiaobai, standing in the center, extended her slender finger and tapped a flickering holographic panel into existence in midair. \\n\\n§M “The rules of this game are very simple: the higher the destruction level and the more impressive your KD (kill-death ratio), the more generous the rewards you can redeem.”§!\\n\\nUpon reading these rules, the proactive Hitomi and Xiaobai exchanged a glance, both curling the corners of their mouths into mischievous grins. They immediately flanked the unsuspecting Linfeng, one in front and one behind. Forcibly pushed toward the city center by her two mischievous companions, Linfeng frantically waved her arms while shouting, “No, please don’t!” However, once Linfeng’s competitive spirit was ignited, she, too, became incredibly eager. Lifting her soft, massive feet, she stomped heavily toward the densest cluster of skyscrapers in the city center. At that moment, inside those skyscrapers—towering hundreds of meters high—countless tiny humans were plunged into utter despair. Through the shattering glass facades, they could only watch in terror as a pale pink sole—so vast it blocked out the sky—slowly closed in, radiating an overwhelming aura of power. Countless tiny persons scrambled frantically like headless flies within the confined spaces, trampling one another as their screams merged into a single, deafening chorus. Linfeng merely applied a tiny bit more force, gently pressing down with the arch of her foot, and the entire sturdy Financial Center tower crumbled and exploded beneath her delicate sole as fragilely as a sandcastle on the beach, turning into a cloud of dust. \\n\\nSeeing Linfeng having such a good time, Su Xiaobai sighed with a touch of resignation, but for the sake of the reward she was determined to claim, she, too, began to stroll elegantly through the city. Her massive, sky-obscuring pink fox tails swept wildly through the air; with every swing, they wiped out entire residential districts as if they were mere rags. Hitomi stood there, tilting her head slightly, silently gazing down at the chaotic, devastating scene below that resembled an anthill. Her enormous bare feet—large enough to block out the sky—were in no hurry to trample everything in sight. Instead, as if plotting some mischievous prank, they hovered leisurely above the super bridge spanning the bay. She deliberately wiggled her fair, delicate toes lightly above the bridge, casting a massive shadow that flickered on and off across the deck, wantonly toying with the hundreds of cars—now linked together like a fiery dragon—as they fled in a frantic panic. As she watched the tiny persons on the bridge sink into hysterical panic and despair at the sight of this inescapable giant foot, the mischievous grin on Hitomi’s lips grew wider. Finally, just as the terrified screams of the tiny persons reached their peak, she seemed to casually step down. With a thunderous “BOOM,” that delicate, perfect giant foot snapped the entire magnificent superbridge in two. Under the immense pressure, countless vehicles on the bridge deck were mercilessly crushed into thin metal discs. Hitomi even gleefully twisted her ankle slightly, maliciously grinding her delicate heel against the broken bridge pier a few times, letting those desperate wails be mercilessly crushed and, along with the alloy debris, lightly kicked into the churning waves.

chinese: 在经历一段时间的狂欢后，各自抱团四散玩弄小人的少女们在最初降临的首都城市圈汇合。六人围坐在几乎化作废墟的深空广播阵列之上，彼此分享先前游玩时的趣闻，语气中满是放松惬意。正在从各个角度夸赞这个小人文明的女孩们丝毫没有留意臀下废墟缝隙里与腿边膜拜舔舐腿部肌肤的小人。\\n\\n她们畅谈下次再来的游玩计划，规划走遍这颗星球每一处山谷、沙滩、湖泊，而对于小人们而言巨娘们的每一次降临、每一场嬉闹都会带来灭顶之灾。\\n\\n夜色缓缓笼罩整片破碎首都，少女们占据着整个城市，依照着破灭磨损的灯火围绕着还算完整的地标性建筑席地而睡。庞大身躯压在残存建筑上，剩余少量完好楼宇持续崩解。肌肤偶尔会感受到悉悉索索的动静，少女们也是内心忍不住轻笑，肆意体会着对小人们的优越感。\\n\\n废墟中涩涩发抖的小人们，听着楼层上方六尊少女平缓的呼吸声，心底只剩无尽悲凉。\\n\\n初入群星的人们曾经以为，包容与善意能够联结银河所有生命，却忽略了体型、认知、生存立场之间无法跨越的鸿沟。一句毫无保留的度假宣传，让整个文明沦为六位巨娘排解压力的玩具沙盘。
english: After a period of revelry, the girls—who had been scattered in small groups, each toying with their Tiny people—converged on the metropolitan area of the capital city where they had first arrived. The six of them sat in a circle atop the Deep Space Broadcasting Array, now reduced to near ruins, sharing amusing anecdotes from their earlier adventures, their voices full of relaxation and contentment. The girls, who were praising this miniature civilization from every angle, paid no attention whatsoever to the tiny people nestled in the cracks of the ruins beneath their seats or those at their feet, worshipfully licking the skin of their legs. \\n\\nThey chatted animatedly about their plans for their next visit, mapping out a journey to explore every valley, beach, and lake on this planet—yet for the Tiny persons, every arrival and every playful frolic by the Giantesses brought with it a catastrophe of epic proportions. \\n\\nNight slowly enveloped the shattered capital. The girls took over the entire city, sleeping on the ground around the relatively intact landmarks by the light of broken and dimmed lamps. Their massive bodies pressed down on the remaining structures, causing the few intact buildings to continue crumbling. Occasionally, their skin would sense a faint rustling sound, and the girls couldn’t help but chuckle inwardly, reveling in their sense of superiority over the tiny people. \\n\\nThe tiny people, trembling nervously amid the ruins, listened to the steady breathing of the six girls above them, their hearts filled with nothing but endless desolation. \\n\\nThose who first set foot among the Stars had once believed that tolerance and goodwill could unite all life in the Milky Way, yet they overlooked the unbridgeable chasm between size, perception, and approaches to survival. A single, unreserved vacation promotion had reduced an entire civilization to a sandbox toy for six Giantesses to relieve their stress.
